caption: The drawing depicts a single metal kettle with a rounded body, a wide spout that curves upward, and a thick, arched handle attached at two points on either side of the lid. The kettle is primarily rendered in various shades of brown and copper, with areas of darker and lighter tones that indicate both light reflection and shadow. The handle and attachments are shown in a muted yellowish-brown to suggest brass or another metal. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "H.A. Marsh," is visible in small blue letters near the lower right side of the kettle.
title: Tea Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
